attackReference.description: Existing Attack 5 / Specialist 2 air tools with Attack-primary ground tools; same simulation rules. The Downburst policy correction does not affect these tier-2 Specialist builds.

checks: Every preparation budget reconciles with previous income
Winning fleets actually finish their selected primary and secondary paths
tradeoffWitnesses: Speed crane and blower builds clear isolated one-hit arrivals sooner than Attack builds.
Traction crane and blower builds cross rough terrain sooner; Speed wins clear-floor travel.
Specialist crane splash clears denser clusters; Attack retains direct armor damage.
Downburst lowers armored targets for ground tools without gaining direct armor damage.
All 160 upgrade steps retain outcome witnesses; all 936 legal builds retain modeled tradeoffs.
limitations: The final gate commits both reserved cranes and the blower to each primary, with a separately paid Attack crane and Attack-primary ground fleet. Independent chassis cases are preliminary comparisons. These fixed six-seed strategies do not guarantee every composition or measure human win rates.
